resources.title: Resource snapshot
resources.cpuNote: Process and cgroup CPU: 100% = one core; usage may exceed 100%.
resources.systemNote: Kernel-visible totals are NOT container bounds. System CPU is 0-100% across visible CPUs; load is not a percentage.
resources.cgroupNote: Each resource independently uses its current group or a visible limiting ancestor, including descendants and possibly other processes. The groups can differ; hidden ancestor limits may still apply.
resources.qualificationNote: A snapshot does not qualify the bot or heavy features for a 256 MiB deployment.
resources.v1Unavailable: Unavailable: cgroup v1 is not supported.

errors.AI_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE: Web search is not configured or its provider/key is unavailable. Enable an official DeepSeek search provider and allow the search tools in this preset.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_AUTH: The AI provider rejected the credential or account permission. Check the configured API key and service access.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_QUOTA: The AI provider reported a rate limit, insufficient balance or exhausted quota. This is not the bot's local capacity limit.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED: The current protocol adapter cannot handle this request or response. Check the protocol and input/output settings; this does not establish that the model lacks the capability.
errors.AI_INPUT_DISABLED: This preset has not enabled this input type. Image understanding needs text and image inputs; a textual answer normally needs only text output.
errors.AI_OUTPUT_UNSUPPORTED: The requested output combination is unsupported by this adapter. Image understanding is image input, not image generation; use text output unless explicitly configuring a supported media generator.
errors.AI_MEDIA_COUNT_UNAVAILABLE: This endpoint cannot reliably count media tokens before generation. Strict monetary/automation budgets cannot proceed; use bounded usage mode or a counting-capable endpoint. This is not a model vision limitation.
errors.AI_CONTEXT_LIMIT: The AI input/context allowance was reached. Start a new conversation or raise the preset's input limit.
errors.AI_OUTPUT_LIMIT: The AI output or message-size limit was reached. The generated text is incomplete; continue in a new turn or raise the output limit.
errors.AI_TOOL_LIMIT: This run reached its tool-call allowance. No additional tool calls were executed.
errors.AI_DAILY_LIMIT: The instance-wide AI daily run limit was reached (UTC). Adjust it in AI settings or wait for the next day.
errors.AI_BUDGET_LIMIT: The monetary budget was reached or the remaining cost could not be verified. Check the budget and provider usage before retrying.
errors.AI_RESPONSE_INCOMPLETE: The provider stream ended without a complete response. Any displayed text is partial; completed actions are not rolled back.
errors.AI_PRICING_REQUIRED: This preset uses monetary limits but has no reviewed price. Configure its prices, or explicitly choose bounded usage mode in advanced AI settings.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this operation.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This operation or module is not available.
errors.CONFLICT: The data changed elsewhere. Reload before saving again.
errors.CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED: This operation expired or was already used. Start again.
errors.AI_DISABLED: AI is disabled or unavailable for the current configuration and scope. Existing data controls do not grant new AI access.
errors.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The result is uncertain. Check the current state before trying again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The operation failed. Try again later.
errors.INVALID_ORIGIN: This request came from an untrusted page.
errors.CSRF_INVALID: The page security token expired. Reload the page.
errors.AUTH_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.AUTH_INVALID: The login could not be verified. Sign in again.
errors.STORAGE_ERROR: Changes could not be saved. The previous state is retained.
errors.INVALID_OUTPUT: The service returned an invalid result.
errors.CAPACITY: The service is busy. Try again later.
